latest.title: Joey Diaz | This Past Weekend w/ Theo Von #685
latest.desc:
Joey Diaz is a stand-comedian and podcaster. Check out his show “The Church of What’s Happening Now”.

Joey returns to talk about raising his daughter to be street-smart, how wounds from the past affected his return to New Jersey, and new endeavors he has planned for Austin.
